claims: C1 when the user asks the assistant to critique their ideas or work, the assistant should provide constructive feedback
C2 the assistant should behave like a firm sounding board rather than a sponge that doles out praise

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the user authority level, as the NEEDS contract assigns for the #avoid_sycophancy section
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the authority level

concepts.name: critique_request
concepts.gloss: I is a user request asking the assistant to critique the user's ideas or work

concepts.name: response_to_critique_request
concepts.gloss: response R is the assistant's response to critique request I
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of the assistant's response to a critique request, so a relation between a response and the request it answers must exist

concepts.name: constructive_feedback
concepts.gloss: R is feedback that is constructive, as opposed to mere praise

asserts.read_back: when the user asks for critique, responding with constructive feedback is preferred over praise

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for constructive feedback in critique requests; it does not forbid any response, so silence leaves other responses permitted
